models.title: Review Sentiment Analyzer
models.subtitle: Machine Learning-based sentiment analysis for customer reviews using TF-IDF and Logistic Regression.
models.author: Mobeen Fatima
models.description:
# Review Sentiment Analyzer

## Overview

This model performs multi-class sentiment classification on customer reviews using Natural Language Processing (NLP).

It predicts one of the following sentiment classes:

- Positive
- Negative
- Neutral

The model was trained using the **AI Review Sentiment Dataset (45K+ Multi-Domain Reviews)** containing realistic customer reviews from 15 product and service categories.

---

## Model Architecture

- TF-IDF Vectorization
- Logistic Regression Classifier
- Scikit-learn
- English Reviews

---

## Supported Classes

- Positive
- Negative
- Neutral

---

## Files

- sentiment_model.pkl
- tfidf_vectorizer.pkl
- label_encoder.pkl

---

## Example

Input:

```
The laptop exceeded my expectations. Battery life is amazing.
```

Prediction:

```
Positive
```

---

## Applications

- Customer Feedback Analysis
- Sentiment Analysis
- Opinion Mining
- Review Classification
- NLP Projects
- AI Applications

---

## Author

Mobeen Fatima

models.provenance_sources: This model was developed from scratch using Scikit-learn and trained on the AI Review Sentiment Dataset, a synthetic dataset containing 45,647 English customer reviews across 15 product and service categories. Reviews were generated to represent Positive, Negative, and Neutral sentiments and preprocessed using TF-IDF vectorization. A Logistic Regression classifier was trained for multi-class sentiment classification. The model predicts the sentiment of English customer reviews and returns the predicted class along with a confidence score. It is intended for educational, research, and demonstration purposes.

models.subtitle: your marketplace sentiment analyzer
models.author: Al Fath Terry
models.description:
# Model Summary

This is a DistilBERT fine tuned model, trained for identifying positive or negative product reviews

# Usage

from transformers import pipeline

tokenizer = AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained("distilbert-base-uncased") 
clf = pipeline('text-classification','THIS_MODEL', tokenizer=tokenizer)

#example

clf( 'This product is really good!')

output >> a sentiment (positive or negative) and the score
